# vendor/roller

The `@randsum/roller` build from [RANDSUM/randsum@825f79e](https://github.com/RANDSUM/randsum/tree/825f79efd1bc6b0539de8d35979b6bb39a49d13b/packages/roller), the last change to roller before this mirror was synced. The reference adapter in `examples/randsum-roller/` runs against it, so the vectors are always tested against the roller they were written beside, released or not. Install `@randsum/roller` from npm to use the roller itself. MIT, see `LICENSE`.
